record.original_question: Do there exist two non-isometric towers of spherical manifolds, indexed by the same poset and related by finite-sheeted covering maps, such that at every level the two manifolds are isospectral?

evidence.quote: Question 1.12. Do there exist isospectral towers of spherical manifolds?
In Section 6 we will completely answer this question by constructing isospectral towers of lens spaces.

artifact.status_search_result: The question is answered affirmatively via explicit constructions of isospectral towers of lens spaces.

status_evidence.snippet: In Section 6 we will completely answer this question by constructing isospectral towers of lens spaces.
status_evidence.claim: The existence question is settled positively by constructing isospectral towers of lens spaces.
